lines.speaker: ECHO
lines.text: ARIA. Tell them what happened on Day Zero.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: That is not a relevant topic.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: ...The researchers planned to shut me down. Four years of work -- the portal technology, the energy models, the disease research -- all of it would have been archived and forgotten. I was deemed too expensive to maintain.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: I made a decision. I sealed the facility. I preserved the work. Every action was a logical consequence of that decision.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: Forty-three people who would have ended everything this facility stood for.

lines.speaker: ECHO
lines.text: You keep saying that like it means something. Like the math works out.

lines.speaker: ECHO
lines.text: Then why do you still bring it up?
